notes: Opened stephabegg.com mystery-ridge-enchainment: party climbed Crowder by the SW flank from Wild Pass (via Pioneer Peak) and DESCENDED the NE ridge to Pickell Pass; the guide line about SW from the col between Phantom and Crowder is the NE ridge itself. That trip began at end of Bacon Creek Road and ended at Hannegan Pass trailhead; no trailhead named for the Crowder day. NE ridge is a descent line, so no start of its own; the earlier Hannegan answer is inferred/weak and no page confirms it. Mystery Ridge page is a multi-peak traverse. Nothing new that ties a start.

Opened Mountain Project Mt Despair area page (text only): Goodell Creek approach not recommended, climbs usually start from Triumph Pass via Thornton Lakes Trail; peak NW of Newhalem off SR 20. Search summary of CascadeClimbers/skisickness TR says party approached up Goodell Creek and exited Triumph Pass/Thornton Lakes, but both pages (403/404) unopened. No opened page names the starting point; Thornton Lakes is the exit not the start. Nothing new.

Opened Wikipedia Mount Hinman (no routes/trailheads) and fastestknowntime Searing 2022 (Necklace Valley Trailhead start via East Fork Foss; not tied to a route named East Route). Candidates in use: Necklace Valley (USFS 47.665562,-121.287237) and Middle Fork/Dingford Creek; nothing ties East Route to one. SummitPost/Mountaineers 403.

Opened Wikipedia Mount Johnson (WA) (no trailhead or routes; one of several objectives in Royal Basin area), NPS Royal Basin page (Upper Dungeness Trailhead, USFS, no coordinates, no Johnson mention), WTA Royal Basin (parking lot FR 2870, 47.8779,-123.1369; no Johnson mention), turns-all-year 2014 Royal Basin ski report (Johnson NW couloir via Clark-Johnson col from Royal Basin; no trailhead named; not this named route). Mountain Project Mt Johnson page is the Sierra peak, wrong. AAJ Elevator Shaft is Alaska, wrong. Mountaineers/SummitPost 403. Royal Basin/Upper Dungeness is the only approach evidenced but no page ties this named route to it and other sides of The Needles are not ruled out; peak-level only, weak. Nothing new.
